verified_examples.question: Compare billing across projects and show the top 10.
verified_examples.sql: SELECT p.project_name, SUM(b.gross_bill_value) AS gross_bill_value FROM client_bill_raising b JOIN project_mst p ON b.project_id = p.project_id GROUP BY p.project_id, p.project_name ORDER BY gross_bill_value DESC LIMIT 10

verified_examples.question: Show purchase orders for RDSS-VIZAG.
verified_examples.sql: SELECT p.project_name, f.po_no, f.vendor_name, f.total_value FROM project_mst p JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT po_id, po_project_id FROM po_items) x ON x.po_project_id = p.project_id JOIN po_form f ON f.po_id = x.po_id WHERE p.project_name = 'RDSS-VIZAG' ORDER BY f.total_value DESC LIMIT 50

verified_examples.question: Show purchase orders in 2025.
verified_examples.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(NULLIF(date, ''), '%d-%m-%Y'), '%Y-%m') AS po_month, COUNT(*) AS purchase_order_count, SUM(total_value) AS purchase_value FROM po_form WHERE STR_TO_DATE(NULLIF(date, ''), '%d-%m-%Y') BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY po_month ORDER BY po_month
